think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it has sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/ignore) rather than just “less/more”. 3) If such a sentinel exists and changes semantics (not just intensity), classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s). Otherwise classify as non-special.
